canDoYue: 你識話吊墜跌壞、要書面估價同相片、請店員喺估價單寫維修費，同埋星期五攞返。
canDoEn: Say the pendant was dropped, ask for a written appraisal and a photo, ask for the repair cost on the appraisal, and collect it on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: I dropped this gold pendant last night. Could I get a written appraisal?
dialogue.glossYue: 我尋晚跌咗呢條金吊墜。可唔可以出一份書面估價？
dialogue.say: I dropped this gold pendant last night. Could I get a written appraisal?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. I'll write the appraisal once I've checked the bent pendant.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。我檢查完條彎咗嘅吊墜，就寫嗰份估價。
dialogue.say: Yes. I'll write the appraisal once I've checked the bent pendant.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Could you take a photo of the crack for the claim form?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以影張相，影到裂痕，用嚟交理賠表？
dialogue.say: Could you take a photo of the crack for the claim form?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. This photo shows the crack right beside the gold clasp.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。呢張相睇到裂痕就喺個金扣隔離。
dialogue.say: Yes. This photo shows the crack right beside the gold clasp.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Can you write the repair cost on the appraisal for my insurance company?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以喺估價單寫埋維修費，等我交畀保險公司？
dialogue.say: Can you write the repair cost on the appraisal for my insurance company?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. The repair is two hundred dollars, and I'll write that on the appraisal.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。維修費係二百蚊，我會寫喺估價單上面。
dialogue.say: Yes. The repair is two hundred dollars, and I'll write that on the appraisal.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Can I collect the repaired gold pendant here on Friday afternoon, please?
dialogue.glossYue: 我可唔可以星期五下晝喺度攞返條整好嘅金吊墜？
dialogue.say: Can I collect the repaired gold pendant here on Friday afternoon, please?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. Friday is fine, and the pendant will be ready at four.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。星期五就得，條吊墜四點會準備好。
dialogue.say: Yes. Friday is fine, and the pendant will be ready at four.
